ctx.x: But now, the Dixie Theater -- I mean the Dixie -- I mean there Burt Wheeler Theater, we used to be a club called the Plantation, you see. And it was -- Woolsey -- Charles Woolsey -- I mean he got to be the president of the Showmans, the theatrical organization, you know. And he made his partner a president of this theater, you know -- Burt Wheeler Theater.

And so, I told Mr. Dardo, I said, "Well, maybe I mean you can give it a try. I mean you don't have to do it." I said, "Well, they got extra audiences come up to the Apollo Theater when they would advertise about the tap dancers night, you see. Which was on a Tuesday up there, see." But we did a series of them. And once time we had to do an extra show.
